verdict.rationale: Box AI API is a first-party, documented surface for asking questions, extracting metadata, and summarizing files (box-docs-9, box-docs-12, box-docs-13, box-docs-26), integrated with enterprise permissions and available via Box Hubs and AI agent configs (box-docs-18). This goes beyond announcement into documented, usable API guides with changelog updates showing active shipping. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of AI answer quality or accuracy, and any community corroboration of the AI features themselves (community evidence only covers sync/storage, not AI).
